source.notes: POST /sap/bc/adt/datapreview/ddic?rowNumber=3&ddicEntityName=T000 with an EMPTY request body — the ddic endpoint takes the table name as a query parameter and has nowhere to put a WHERE clause, which is why v1 uses it instead of datapreview/freestyle. 200 with a column-major dataPreview:tableData payload: 17 columns x 2 rows (A4H has only clients 000 and 001, so rowNumber=3 returned fewer rows than requested — this body does NOT exercise the N+1 off-by-one). PINS TWO PARSER TRAPS: (1) empty cells serialise as self-closing <dataPreview:data/> — there are 17 of them here (ADRNR, CCNOCLIIND, CCNOCASCAD, ... in both rows) — and must parse to "" rather than being dropped, or the per-column arrays lose alignment and row assembly by index silently shifts values into the wrong columns; (2) MANDT values are "000"/"001", which regress to the numbers 0/1 unless the parser sets parseTagValue: false. Also pins that <dataPreview:totalRows> is 0 on the ddic endpoint even when rows were returned, so it must never be reported as a row count. Business data is limited to the SAP demo client table (SAP SE / Walldorf / EUR / BWDEVELOPER / A4HCLNT001). Anonymisation: appliance.server is the repo's standing pseudonym for the A4H ApplicationServerName. The appliance's real host name and its container IPv4 are deliberately absent from this file, as is the appliance URL; Authorization / Cookie / X-CSRF-Token request-header values are replaced with placeholders. Response bytes are unmodified. kernelRelease/kernelPatchLevel were read live from GET /sap/bc/adt/system/information on the same day as this capture, not copied from an earlier cassette.
